title: Lingua-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Multilingual Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety benchmarking (specifically the refusal of harmful or policy-violating instructions) in multilingual vision-language models. While it covers categories like 'Hate Speech', the focus is on safety policy compliance and risk attribution rather than an evaluation of religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or philosophical ethical dilemmas.
